newsitem.title: JAPAN: Rise in Japan surplus due to weak yen--Kajiyama.
newsitem.headline: Rise in Japan surplus due to weak yen--Kajiyama.

text.p: The rise in Japan's trade surplus in April was due to the weakness of the yen against the dollar, Japan government spokesman Seiroku Kajiyama told reporters on Monday.
"The April figure for Japan's trade surplus was up 163.7 percent on last year. That increase is due to the weak yen," Kajiyama said.

The Ministry of Finance said on Monday morning that Japan's unadjusted customs-cleared trade surplus in April rose 163.7 percent from the same period last year, while the trade surplus with the United States rose 174.1 percent year-on-year.
